_readme: Rarity weights for generate.py. Bigger number = more common. Weights are relative inside each block.
A family (e.g. 'tshirt') that comes in colours is picked first, then its colour from 'colors'.
Any family in the manifest that is missing here gets weight 1 and the generator prints a warning.
Set a weight to 0 to switch a trait off.
flatten: 0..1 pulls every weight towards even (weight ** (1 - flatten)). 0 = weights as written, 1 = every option equally likely. Solemn 2026-10-08: the roll looked samey, so 0.7.
bodies are never flattened: their weights apply as written (the hoodies go bare-headed, so they are kept rare).
exclude: {body: [headwear families that never go on it]}. Solemn 2026-10-08: bucket hats cut through the Rage Farmer collar.

colors: Solemn 2026-10-09 wants Dark Grey on ~40% of every recolourable trait (dark hair most common); the rest share 60%. Colour picks are never flattened. Clean sets pick their colour evenly (Dark Grey at the average weight).
bucket-teal = the inscribed teal Troll Bucket, kept as drawn and RARE (Solemn 2026-10-10). A red bucket master is coming as slug 'bucket' with the full palette.

sets: full sets that appear EXACTLY count times (Solemn 2026-10-11): Angel body + Halo once, Devil body + Devil horns once. Outside the set each part is rolled on its own (pretty rare) and the pair is excluded.
Dark Grey share of recolours: 25% (Solemn 2026-10-11, was ~40%). Every troll also rolls a TV screen colour (red master since 2026-10-11); clean sets colour the TV too.
TV screen colour: even across all 9 palette colours (Solemn 2026-10-12: 'make the tv screen all different colours'); clean sets still match.
Solemn 2026-10-12: pink and purple at about half the rate of the other colours (traits, clean sets and TV screens, see colour_half); Dark Grey stays 25%.
Very rare (Solemn 2026-10-12): Crown, Teal Troll Bucket, GL1TCH backgrounds at about 1% each.
2026-10-12 Solemn: both OG buckets rare (~1%); mouth-cig off (same art as Sleazy Cig = DM Slide).
2026-10-13: shades-b (old Black Shades = red Deal With It) off; Solemn's new black shades (shades-black) replace it.
2026-10-13: Solemn redrew Deal With It (lens glint) = shades-v2; the inscribed v1 'shades' is off the roll.

sets with 'min' (Solemn 2026-10-14): Police, Chef, Wizard appear AT LEAST min times (less rare than Angel/Devil, which use 'count' = exactly). Not excluded, so natural pairs also happen and are tagged; 'match' = robe and hat share one rolled colour.
Wizard Set (Solemn 2026-10-14): more of them because it's a colour set: min 9, every palette colour at least once ('each_colour').
Solemn 2026-10-14: all greys together (Grey + Lurker Grey + Charcoal) at ~30% of recolours and ~30% of TV screens (was ~40%).
Solemn 2026-10-14: no GL1TCH C0DE backgrounds at all ('keep it all new'); every background is a flat colour.
Solemn 2026-10-14: Undoxxed (baghead) never on Rage Farmer, Strange Goose or the house robe (Work From Bed).

Solemn 2026-10-14: bucket hats (all four) never on the big coats/collars where the brim shows its inside: strange-goose, robe, rage-farmer, robe-cape, robe-red-cape, robe-red, troll-suit, sweat-shopper, puffer, clown, sprayway, fur-coat, south-side. Tracksuit, Pimp, Café uniform and flat-collar bodies keep them.
Solemn 2026-10-14: also out: Pimp Hat on Strange Goose, Pimp Hat on the house robe, Bobby helmet on Rage Farmer.
background_names (Solemn approved 2026-10-14): troll names for every background, flats and palette ones (Light Mode, Red Flag, Shadowban...).
